digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and overlay selection
propositions: The tests overlay is currently selected only by glob matching on changed test files, missing cases where product logic is added without test file changes, allowing bugs to merge with zero test file diffs
A content-based detector must fire when a diff adds a new function/method/class declaration, the same file does not remove that name, and no changed file matches the tests globs
The detector uses the existing polyglot declaration regex _REMOVED_DECL_RE to match added lines, extracts declared names via a separate regex, and suppresses anonymous declarations to fail closed

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow blocking eligibility to findings concerning newly-introduced behaviour (added lines) with named violating inputs, distinguishing from pre-existing code gaps

The implementation adds a keyword-only changed_files parameter to content_triggered_overlays and passes the step's changed list from workflow_ops, keying the negative rule (no test file changed) on file paths rather than diff text

The trigger is portable across languages and repositories: no src/ predicate, no Python-only regex, supports Go func, Rust fn, JS/TS function/arrow/class, Ruby class, keyed only on tests globs and docs/data extension skip
